outcome: allergic sensitisation (IgE sensitisation to aeroallergens or food allergens)
cohort: 854 preterm children diagnosed with asthma or allergic rhinitis before 18 years old.
finding: Early palivizumab prophylaxis in preterm children with asthma or allergic rhinitis decreased risks of aeroallergen sensitisation until 18 years of age and reduced total sIgE levels and eosinophil counts.
